$comment: Generated from RunReport's Zod schemas, held to its type in src/view/report/types.ts by `pnpm schema:update`; don't edit. The RunReport behind a run's summary.md: <run>/report.json in the history folder or .reeval/runs.
title: RunReport

prompts.description: Distinct first-turn prompt hashes over the arm's attempts.

verdict.description: Pass-rate certainty only; measure direction lives in measure cells.

cells.description: One entry per column key; every column present.

diff.description: Lines exclude lockfiles; null counts print `not recorded`.

href.description: The target every `AttemptRef` to this attempt uses.

id.description: The display label, `A1..AN`, numbered over the evals the report covers.

key.description: The attempt's `AttemptRecord.key`, the same in every report of its run.

keys.description: One value per axis, repeated on every row.

reason.description: Why the check was n/a when known (`expect.skip` reason); null otherwise.

options.description: Sorted by count, then by first appearance.

verdictScope.description: `pass-rate` when the contrast is on pass rate; else the measure's own direction.

harness.description: A harness label, or `Median` for the cross-harness row.

foot.description: Sample size, harness count, interval, and floor, as sentences.

kicker.description: What differed (`Revised skill against the JS SDK baseline`); null on a task eval.

task.description: The eval's name: the heading above the headline.

anchor.description: GFM slug of the eval's heading.

name.description: Unique in the report; `<name> (<file>)` when two evals share a name.

primary.description: Null on a check-free eval, whose first choice, judge, or measure block leads.
The eval's headline in one cell, in its native unit.

count.description: Members of the eval's counted attempts.

Figure.description: A displayed number: `value` for charts, `text` as every surface prints it (`461k`, `1m 05s`, `not reported`).

outcome.description: Product outcome noun: passed (default), found, or used.

others.description: Every other variant, with its own interval; never dropped.

leadRole.description: When many answers collapse to one quote shown in the headline.

lead.description: First gated worse/fixed change, else first change row.

text.description: One plain sentence that names the metric it affects.

Interval.description: A 95% interval in the parent's unit. `text`: `+66 pts to +100 pts`.

assertion.description: The `expect(verdict).toPass()` label that gates on it; null for a diagnostic judgment.

atOrAbove.description: Null when `threshold` is null (diagnostic): omit from "At or above".

lower.description: `3 of 4` harnesses lower than the baseline; null on the baseline.

themes.description: From the analysis; null without one.

whatChanged.description: Experimental inputs that changed (`stackChanges` / config), not outcome rows.

cost.description: Null when no attempt or judge call has a cost.

total.description: Labeled total when agent and judge are both present; else null.

runsPerCell.description: Null when cells ran different counts.

tokens.description: `input + output + cacheRead + cacheWrite` (`totalTokens`); null when no attempt reported usage.

actions.description: From the analysis; empty without one.

integrity.description: Empty when clean; the block is then omitted.

roster.description: Empty unless `evals.length >= 2` and two or more harnesses ran.

single.description: `evals.length === 1`: the eval is the `#` title and every block moves up one level.

counted.description: Pass plus fail over gated cells: the pass-rate denominator.

reclassified.description: Of `infraError`: attempts an unhandled turn error moved out of pass or fail.

ungated.description: Ungated cells (baselines by default), never in `counted`.

median.description: The cross-group median row; null with one group.

arms.description: Baseline first, then variants in declaration order.

uniformLead.description: Set when every arm passed every applicable assertion; `assertionsByArm` is then empty.
